title: Warmly Flambeed Russian Kale Pilaf
description: A tangy and creamy Russian dish featuring kale, flambeed to perfection, and suitable for a shojin-friendly diet. This festive pilaf is sure to delight your senses.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and saute until the onion is translucent.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the chopped kale and cook until it wilts.
Add the rice and stir to combine with the kale mixture.
Add the vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes or until the rice is cooked.
Remove the skillet from the heat and add the vodka.
Ignite the vodka and let it flambe for 30 seconds to 1 minute.
Stir in the sour cream and chopped dill.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
